title: CO₂ emissions
description: Annual carbon dioxide emissions by country and year — a large, real table, good for grouping, filtering and plotting a trend over time.

title: Life expectancy
description: Life expectancy at birth, in years, by country and year from 1950. Three columns, so it is an easy first dataset to reason about. Fetched live from Our World in Data when it runs, with a saved copy as the backup.
source: Our World in Data, compiling Riley, Zijdeman et al., the Human Mortality Database and the UN World Population Prospects

title: Pride and Prejudice (full text)
description: The whole novel as plain text — for counting words, measuring sentence length, or any other question you can ask of a large piece of writing.

title: Dinosaur genera
description: Every dinosaur genus from before 66 million years ago that the Paleobiology Database lists: who named it and when, how old its fossils are, and how many have been found.

title: Dinosaur fossil finds
description: One row for each dinosaur fossil find, with where it was found and how old the rock is: a good dataset for asking who has been looking, and where.

title: Tides at Dublin Port
description: The height of the sea at Dublin Port, every hour through March 2026: two tides a day, and a bigger rhythm across the month.
source: Marine Institute, Irish National Tide Gauge Network

title: Dublin's weather, day by day
description: Temperature and sunlight in Dublin every day from 2023 to 2025. A year of it rises and falls like a wave.

title: Sunrise, sunset and daylight
description: When the Sun rose and set on every day of 2026 in Reykjavik, Dublin, Accra and Cape Town, and how many hours of daylight each place had.
license: Facts about the sky, credited to NASA/JPL

title: Characters in six novels
description: How often each main character is named in each chapter of six novels, from Pride and Prejudice to The War of the Worlds. The chapters' word counts are in book-chapters.csv.

title: CO₂ per person, by country
description: Emissions divided by population, so large and small countries can be compared fairly — the same measure, per person, everywhere.

title: Share of electricity from renewables
description: The percentage of each country's electricity that came from renewable sources, year by year — a good dataset for asking who changed fastest.

title: Population, by country and year
description: How many people lived in each country, year by year — most useful joined onto another dataset, to turn a total into a rate.
